title: Opinion and Limits: a juicio de, al margen de
goal: Give someone's judgement with a juicio de and set a topic aside with al margen de.
grammar: a juicio de, al margen de

items: I can use *a juicio de* to give someone's opinion.
I can use *al margen de* to set something aside.
I can tell a judgement (*a juicio de*) from a source (*según*).
